title: tragacantha placens
intro: Tragacantha placens, commonly known as the globe thistle or Echinops ritro, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Tragacantha placens include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Tragacantha placens include sesquiterpene lactones, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-cancer effects.
